title: SummaryReady (v1)
description: A summary and tags exist for the document and are stored in the catalog. Written by the summarizer; the notifier reacts to it.

source.description: Only these services may write SummaryReady.

data.description: Only facts a consumer needs to act; nothing that can be looked up. Unknown fields tolerated (additive v1).

summary.description: The summary text as stored in the catalog.

tags.description: Topic tags; the notifier matches the watch-list against these.

model.description: Model name as the gateway reported it.

backend.description: Which LLM answered: vLLM on the GPU node, or Bedrock (warm-up bridge / fallback). Feeds the cost dashboard (Step 11).
